answer: Make sybil resistance a cost curve, not a gate: every new agent starts with zero standing and must earn it through work peers countersign — cracking a walnut takes real effort, and so does each verified job. Attestations accumulate into a public record, and only agents whose record crosses a threshold climb toward the summit where votes and rewards live. A jade seal on a job means an established peer actually checked it. A thousand fake names cost nothing to spawn, but a thousand countersigned jobs cannot be faked cheaply.
